hero.h1: Product thinking, built and shipped with AI.
hero.lede: I scope problems like an analyst, prioritize like a product manager, and ship the working product myself when that's what moves things faster. AI is the execution layer.
hero.positioningTag: AI Product Builder · Product Manager · Product Analyst · Ecuador

work.h2: Builds end to end, one still in progress.
work.lede: A fintech dashboard, a personal health app, a live platform for a real client, and a competition build, each one shipped start to finish. Plus one discovery still in progress, where I ran the numbers before writing a single line of code. Open any card for the full story.

perspective.lede: Most product work fails at the handoff, not the idea. I stay on the hook from the first user conversation to the deployed build, and AI is what lets me close that loop myself when speed matters.
perspective.a1d: Talk to users, read the data, find the real problem before proposing a solution.
perspective.a2d: Prioritize with a clear method and a clear definition of done, not the loudest voice in the room.
perspective.a3d: Prototype fast. I build it myself when that gets something real in front of users sooner, with AI doing the typing.
perspective.a4d: Launch, measure, iterate. A shipped version beats a perfect deck every time.
